title: Zeughaus Innsbruck Landesmuseum
highlights: Ehemaliges kaiserliches Waffenarsenal Maximilians I. aus dem frühen 16. Jahrhundert
Vierflügelige Renaissance-Anlage mit stimmungsvollem Innenhof an der Sill
Umfassende Dauerausstellung zur Kultur-, Sozial- und Technikgeschichte Tirols
Beliebter Veranstaltungsort für sommerliche Open-Air-Kinos und Konzerte
kurzbeschreibung: The Zeughaus Innsbruck was once an imperial armoury and now presents Tyrol's eventful cultural and technological history.
beschreibung:
From Armoury to History Museum

The Zeughaus Innsbruck was built between 1500 and 1505 on the orders of Kaiser Maximilian I. on the banks of the Sill as a modern weapons arsenal. The expansive complex, featuring two elongated wings and defensive towers, stands as an outstanding testament to imperial fortress architecture.

A Journey Through Tyrol's History

Today, the Tiroler Landesmuseen showcase a fascinating exhibition on the region's cultural and technological history within the historic vaults. From prehistory through mining and industrialisation to modern times, the identity of Tyrol is vividly brought to life.
